name: Ilkal Saree Handloom Weaving & Dyeing Trail
description: An immersive guided walk through the historic weaver quarters (Nekara Mohallas) of Ilkal. Tourists observe master weavers working on traditional pit looms, learn about the loop-knotting Kondi technique for the signature red 'Tope Teni' seragu, explore natural vegetable and vat dyeing units, and interact directly with artisan families.
location: Ilkal Weaver Colonies, Ilkal Taluk, Bagalkote District
inclusive_growth_pillar: AI-Based Local Artisan Recommendation & Tourist-Skill Matching
skill_transferred: Understanding pit-loom mechanics, warp-weft mathematics, and Kasuti counting embroidery
pricing_indicative: ₹500 - ₹1,200 per person (Direct fee to artisan guide collective)
source: Official Bagalkote District Portal (Handloom Tourism Committee)

name: Guledagudda Khana Dobby Weaving Workshop
description: A hands-on cultural workshop where tourists sit alongside traditional weavers in Guledagudda to learn how complex geometric dobby patterns (Choukadi, Tulasi Katti) are mounted onto handlooms. Participants try their hand at the shuttle and receive a customized swatch of authentic GI-tagged Khana cloth.
location: Guledagudda Valley Weaver Clusters, Guledagudda Taluk, Bagalkote District
skill_transferred: Dobby mechanism operation and geometric motif interpretation

name: Badami Cliff & Agastya Lake Dawn Heritage Walk
description: An early morning walking trail around the tranquil red sandstone cliffs of Agastya Lake, exploring ancient rock inscriptions, the subterranean Bhoothanatha temples, hidden cave shrines, and panoramic viewpoints overlooking the ancient capital of Vatapi.
location: Agastya Lake Circuit, Badami, Bagalkote District
skill_transferred: Deciphering Chalukyan rock sculpture iconography and lake hydrology
source: Archaeological Survey of India & Karnataka Tourism

name: Traditional Jolada Rotti & North Karnataka Culinary Experience
description: A participatory village cooking experience led by local women chefs. Visitors learn the delicate art of hand-patting unleavened sorghum flour into paper-thin Jolada Rottis over earthen hearths, pounding spicy roasted peanut chutney (Shenga Chutney Pudi) in stone pestles, and preparing spicy stuffed brinjal (Ennegayi).
location: Badami / Pattadakal Rural Surroundings, Bagalkote District
inclusive_growth_pillar: AI-Based Local Business Promotion & Women Skill Matching
skill_transferred: Sorghum dough kneading, hot-water hand-patting technique, traditional stone grinding

name: Sharana Vachana & Dasoha Pilgrimage Experience
description: A guided cultural journey through Kudala Sangama exploring the egalitarian Sharana movement of the 12th century. Includes an interactive study of Basava Vachanas in translation, a boat ride to the cylindrical river Aikya Mantapa, meditation in the Poojavana sacred grove, and participation in the universal community Dasoha meal.
location: Kudala Sangama, Hunagund Taluk, Bagalkote District
skill_transferred: Vachana lyrical recitation, egalitarian social history, and meditative reflection
